| Script | What | Note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pilot-land.mjs` | `<key> [--branch retro/<x>] [--check-command <command>] [--integration <branch>] [--main <branch>] [--resolver <module>] [--load-max <n>]`, `sync-main` with the same options but `--branch` (runs in the checkout, finding it with `git worktree list`; creates the stage worktree through the `orca-worktree-create.mjs` beside it with `$ORCA_CLI_COMMAND` when there is none, then runs the `pilot-unbare.sh` beside it; the regression command runs with `sh -c` in the stage worktree, default `bin/check`; `--resolver` names a module relative to the repo root, a missing one is a usage error; load threshold `--load-max`, else `$PILOT_LOAD_MAX`, else 3 × cores) | Before staging anew (not on `RESUME`) and when the checkout has an `origin` remote, it first runs the `sync-main` steps below so the integration branch contains `origin/<main>` (#366): nothing is printed when it already does, otherwise `SYNCED <sha> ff` or `SYNCED <sha> [<CHECK_PASS line>]` comes before `STAGED`, and a failed sync prints the `sync-main` STOP line and stages nothing. Stage merges each `done` member by number onto `pilot/stage-<key>` from the integration tip and writes `current: staged <sha> onto <tip>`, Regression appends `regression: <sha> exit <code>` (with the output's last line when it starts with `CHECK_PASS `, the full output in `reg-<key>.log`), Integrate fast-forwards the integration branch and writes `current: merged <sha>`, each write read back: `STAGED <key> <sha> onto <tip>` or `RESUME <key> <sha>` (an unchanged staged SHA whose regression passed), `RESOLVED <n> <techniques> <file…>` per merge it resolved (a `workflow-templates.json` conflict is recomputed as `restamp`; every other file goes to the resolver's `resolveFile`, project stamp files to its `restamp`), `UNBARE <checkout>`, then `POSTLAND_PENDING <n> <command>` for each `postland:` line of a `done` member (by member number, then file order; also on a rerun of a merged batch, and none when there are no such lines), then last `MERGED <key> <sha>`; or `STOP load <load> <threshold>`, `STOP member <n> <state>` (a `running` member's screen is read first with the probe's worker parsing: when every running member shows a result line it prints `WORKER <n> DONE <sha>` or `WORKER <n> STOP <cause>` (or, for an exited terminal, `WORKER <n> DONE <sha> from-state` as the probe judges it, reading only the default worker checkpoint path), writes them back as `--apply` does, and goes on; otherwise `STOP member <n> running (<worker state>)，先跑 pilot-probe.mjs --apply` with no row changed), `STOP dirty <worktree>`, `STOP no-stage-worktree`, `STOP create …`, `STOP conflict <n> <file>=<source>:<kind> …` (merge aborted; source `member <m>`, `integration`, joined by `+`, or `unknown`; kind from the resolver's `conflictKind`, else `code` or `other`), `STOP regression <exit>`, `STOP load slot-timeout <seconds>s` (the regression runs through `heavy-slot.mjs`'s machine-wide slot, label `<main checkout dir>:regression`, and no slot came free in time: the regression line records `exit 75`; a load gate like `STOP load`, rerun later), `STOP hold`, `STOP held <n> <gate id>` (an open gate holds back done member #n; checked before the load gate and staging, nothing touched), `STOP operator-questions <n> <count>` (done member #n's issue-run checkpoint, `.scratch/issue-run-<n>/state.md` in its row's worktree, has `<count>` `[confirm]` ruling lines and no gate in `gates.md`, open or resolved, names #n as its Issue; checked right after the held check, nothing touched; open the gate and rerun), `STOP drift` (the integration tip moved since staging), `STOP checkpoint …`, `STOP merge <n> …`, `STOP git …`, the integration branch untouched (except by a pre-stage sync that already printed `SYNCED`). `--branch retro/<x>` with key `req-<n>` first creates `batch-req-<n>.md` with that branch as its one `-` member. `sync-main` makes the integration branch contain `origin/<main>`: `SYNCED <tip> current`, `SYNCED <sha> ff`, or, after merging and passing the regression, `RECORDED <key>` per merged batch it appended `regression: <sha> exit 0 sync-main …` to, then `SYNCED <sha> [<CHECK_PASS line>]`; the same STOP lines with `sync-main` in place of `<n>` | 0 `MERGED` or `SYNCED`; 4 `STOP`; 3 `CHECKPOINT_LOCKED` ([Checkpoint lock](#checkpoint-lock)); 1 a program error |
